title: Lesson frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter at the top of every content/**/*.md lesson. The Markdown body is the lesson text.

objectives.description: What the learner should be able to do afterwards.

key_facts.description: Short, self-contained facts a candidate could be asked on a written exam or oral: numbers, definitions, rule requirements, sequences. Shown to the learner as an 'Exam focus' card. Each fact must be supported by the lesson's source_ids.

figures.description: Pictures the learner can open from inside the lesson. Each one has a source drawing content/figures/<id>.svg and a rendered content/figures/<id>.png, and is placed in the body with a line {{figure:<id>}}.

id.description: File name stem, unique across all lessons.

caption.description: Short label shown on the Show picture button.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in plain sentences. Read by TalkBack and read aloud, so it must carry the point of the picture.

audio.description: Reserved for the text-to-speech lane. Not used in the first release.
